run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline to relax a slab with an adsorbate using a pretrained ML calculator
generate_adsorbate_slab_configurations: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab and list of adsorbates using ocp_adslab_generator
relax_atoms_structure: relax an atomic structure using ASE optimizer and return energy and forces via relax_job
reference_adsorbate_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to gas phase and slab energies using atomic reference values
detect_adsorbate_anomalies: detect anomalies like dissociation, desorption, surface changes, or intercalation between initial and final atomic structures
